senses.gloss: being inclined, i.e. giving a verdict according to the majority of votes (Ex. XXIII, 2 אחרי רבים להטות).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 1:6">Snh. I, 6</cite> <he>לא כהַטָּיָיתְךָ וכ׳</he> thy verdict against the defendant must not be given in the same way as thy verdict of acquittal; for the latter suffices a majority of one, for the former there must be a majority of two.

senses.gloss: (euphem.) performing coition with a virgin without causing a bleeding.
